_about: Mike Step 14.1 (flashlight embedding), English. 'routing': zero-shot labels with a description and three anchor examples, and test sentences that never appear among the anchors. 'retrieval': questions over Luna's guide blocks (flashlight_blocks.py), each with its acceptable block ids; 'outside': questions the guide does not answer.

small_talk.description: casual chat, greetings, feelings and opinions, with no task to do

guide_question.description: a question about how Luna, its desktop, its voice dictation or its agents work

luna_action.description: an order to do something on the desktop: open, close, move or focus a window or an app
anchors: Put the calculator on the left.
